route.meaning: Red when an active path can be verified by a single DVN with no optional threshold. Amber when every DVN on the path is operated by the same name, or block confirmations are below 15.

peer.meaning: Red when a single wallet owns the OApp. Amber when ownership sits behind a contract without a time delay.

supply.meaning: Difference between the sum of remote supply and the amount locked in the adapter. Red above 1 percent, amber above 0.1 percent.
